title: Nightly version 2122091407 & 2122091408
body:
Hello.

I have a OnePlus 8 Pro Android 12.1
I have been trying to get the latest version of xDrip+ 2122091408.
But every time I try to install it.
It falls back to 2122091407, which I already have installed.

I restarted the phone, to make sure that wasn't an issue.
I have checked that all permissions are given to xdrip+ and everything is given.
I have tried external download and install, still says "finished" at the end, but it returns to 2122091407.
